independenceStatement: This reviewer did not author or modify the reviewed production UI, validation harness, fixture, or immutable browser collection. The reviewer wrote only the assigned reviewer-report.json and reviewer-report.md and did not touch production UI, tests, collection inputs, prior evidence, frozen design artifacts, specifications, task checkboxes, owner artifacts, Git staging, or commits.

buildIdentity.displayScaleBasis: The 1280x760 PNG equals the recorded 1280x760 CSS viewport; this is the browser capture scale and is not a claim about a physical macOS display.

contractConsistency.statement: DESIGN.md, the confirmed UX brief decisions, the approved HF-2 README/components/tokens/manifest package, and the current 003 spec/plan/UI contract agree for the HF2-04 Overlay Light checkpoint: Overlay leaves the canvas box unchanged, shell boundaries remain unmasked, geometry uses +/-2 CSS px, raster tolerance is auxiliary component-crop only, and owner approval/native package evidence are not required at this intermediate gate.

reviewedCollections.role: semantic browser authority and fixed browser screenshot

remediationChecks.expected: First Tab x=88, corresponding to the frozen baseline underline near x=89, within the declared +/-2 CSS px shell geometry tolerance.
remediationChecks.actual: The immutable collector records first Tab x=88; visual inspection confirms that the active first Tab begins immediately after the compact Sidebar/Back group.

remediationChecks.expected: Flow is dirty and exposes exactly one visible circular unsaved marker in addition to its accessible dirty state.
remediationChecks.actual: The immutable collector records save-state=dirty and visible-unsaved-marker=1 for fixture-overlay-flow; the marker is clearly visible in the unmasked Tab strip.

remediationChecks.expected: The fixed Overlay key screen captures the compact Sidebar toggle at rest with transparent/default background after the pointer moves away.
remediationChecks.actual: The remediated actual shows the Sidebar toggle at rest with no retained lavender hover surface; Back is also at rest.

visualChecks.expected: The 360px Overlay Sidebar covers the left editor area while its header, tree, divider, shadow, and full perimeter remain visible and reviewable.
visualChecks.actual: The Overlay Sidebar is visibly layered above the SDK editor and its shell-owned perimeter is not concealed by the SDK exclusion.

visualChecks.check: Canvas box remains unchanged when Overlay opens and closes
visualChecks.expected: Canvas x, y, width, and height remain exactly unchanged before and after the Overlay transition.
visualChecks.actual: The bound collector reports exact before/after equality at x=0, y=44, width=1280, and height=716. This geometry was accepted from structured assertions and not re-proved from pixels.

visualChecks.expected: Back is a compact enabled 32x32 icon control beside Sidebar for the valid-history fixture.
visualChecks.actual: Back is visibly compact and the collector reports enabled semantics plus exact 32x32 geometry.

visualChecks.expected: The first Tab begins immediately after the compact Sidebar/Back group at x=88, aligning with the frozen baseline underline near x=89 within +/-2 CSS px.
visualChecks.actual: The collector records x=88 and the remediated capture visibly removes the prior 52px additional gap.

visualChecks.expected: The dirty Flow Tab has one visible circular unsaved marker in addition to accessible state.
visualChecks.actual: Flow.excalidraw visibly contains one circular marker; clean System Map and Research Tabs contain none.

visualChecks.expected: The Overlay key screen captures the compact Sidebar toggle at rest with transparent/default background.
visualChecks.actual: The fixed actual shows the Sidebar toggle at rest after the pointer moved away; no hover background remains.

visualChecks.check: Light shell composition outside SDK interior
visualChecks.expected: The compact controls, Tabs, Overlay Sidebar, Workspace header/tree, shell boundary, and overlay perimeter preserve the approved restrained Light composition.
visualChecks.actual: All app-owned shell regions remain visible, coherent, and unmasked; differences inside the official editor interior are excluded only by the declared SDK mask.

compositionChecks.evidenceSource: 003-shell-v3 collector semantic assertions and visual inspection

compositionChecks.check: The Sidebar toggle is captured in the baseline default state rather than hover

legacyRemoval.control: large textual Pin or Unpin control
persistent normal-state All changes saved strip
Unicode placeholder tree or file icons
duplicate current-workspace heading or workspace navigation state
legacyRemoval.evidenceSource: collector workspace-root assertion and visual inspection

maskRationale: The single declared selector is accepted only for the visible official Excalidraw SDK editor interior. The review did not exclude the Overlay Sidebar, its shadow/perimeter, the top Tabs, Sidebar/Back controls, Workspace header, tree rows, or any shell boundary, even where the Overlay is visually stacked above the underlying editor.

tolerances.browserGeometryTolerance: +/-2 CSS px; the bound collector owns canvas-box, Back, and first-Tab measurements

rasterOnlyTolerance.scope: collector-owned auxiliary workspace-sidebar same-semantic component crop only

findings.screenState: 04 · Workspace · Overlay · Light / top Tab strip placement
findings.expected: First Tab x=88, corresponding to the frozen baseline underline near x=89 within +/-2 CSS px.
findings.actual: The collector records x=88 and actual.png visibly removes the prior additional gap.
findings.reproduction: Open the manifest-verified baseline and immutable actual separately at native 1280x760. Inspect the first active Tab immediately after the compact controls, then confirm geometry.overlay.first-tab.x in assertions.json is 88.

findings.screenState: 04 · Workspace · Overlay · Light / Flow.excalidraw dirty Tab
findings.expected: The dirty Flow Tab exposes exactly one visible circular unsaved marker in addition to accessible dirty state.
findings.actual: The collector records save-state=dirty and visible-unsaved-marker=1; actual.png visibly shows the single marker.
findings.reproduction: Open actual.png at native 1280x760 and inspect Flow.excalidraw in the unmasked Tab strip; then confirm the fixture-overlay-flow semantic assertions in assertions.json.

findings.screenState: 04 · Workspace · Overlay · Light / Sidebar toggle rest state
findings.expected: The fixed Overlay key screen captures the compact Sidebar toggle at rest with transparent/default background.
findings.actual: The actual captures the Sidebar toggle at rest; the prior lavender hover surface is absent.
findings.reproduction: Open the manifest-verified baseline and actual separately at native 1280x760 and compare the top-left Sidebar control backgrounds after the capture pointer has moved away.

unverified: A native macOS package, bundle identifier, native window, physical display scale, native menus, and system dialogs were not reviewed; they are intentionally outside this intermediate browser-only checkpoint.
The browser engine name and version and exact collection-time macOS version are not present in environment.json.
The recorded browser capture scale is derived from matching PNG and CSS viewport dimensions and does not establish the physical macOS display scale.

Back-history behavior, Overlay hold/Escape behavior, persistence, accessibility, keyboard operation, focus-visible, reduced motion, token values, font fallback, mask semantics, and legacy counts were not re-proved from pixels; the immutable collector and focused regressions own those facts.
HF2-01, HF2-02, VSL-001/HF2-03, HF2-05, and HF2-06 were not reviewed by this single-screen checkpoint.
No product-owner decision was created or inferred because ownerRequirement is NOT_REQUIRED for HF2-04.
